message: I hate t-Netix too.  Every time you turn around your phone is blocked.  I have a friend that is in a correctional facility that has a waiting line to use the phone and it's irretating to not be able to answer the phone because there is a block.  I also hate the fact that you can't go threw your long distant carrier for inmate phone usage.  It takes t-netix a long time to give back a refund for calls that were disconnected for no reason.  They always tell you that they have to send in a trouble ticket that might take up to several weeks for it to be investigated and refunded.  Every time you need to speak to a manager thier is noone available.  I hate t-netix.
